auditor_role: destructive internal auditor / harsh CVPR reviewer / ML systems + stats + adversarial QA

bugs_found.title: Certification policy leaks required evidence status into a module-global allowlist
bugs_found.mechanism: evaluate_certification_policy() mutated the module-level _REVIEWED_OR_STRONGER set with policy['evidence_status_required']. A single call with a custom/permissive required status permanently widened the allowlist, so a later default-policy call accepted a non-evidence status (e.g. GENERATED_EDIT_ONLY).
bugs_found.exploit: Confirmed: after one call with evidence_status_required=GENERATED_EDIT_ONLY, a default-policy call with evidence_statuses=[GENERATED_EDIT_ONLY] returned policy_passed=True.
bugs_found.mitigation_pre_fix: Integrated pipeline ANDs this gate with the claims.py deny-list, which still blocked GENERATED_EDIT_ONLY, so end-to-end certification was not produced; the policy gate itself was defeated and the leak is order-dependent / exploitable when policy_passed is consumed standalone.
bugs_found.fix: Build the accepted-status set locally (accepted = _REVIEWED_OR_STRONGER | {required}); never mutate the global.

bugs_found.title: Paper-number guard bypass via em-dash / placeholder line-skip and leading-dot decimals
bugs_found.mechanism: extract_paper_numbers() skipped any results-prose line containing a PLACEHOLDER_TOKEN, but '--' matches ordinary em-dashes (---), en-dashes and ranges (10--20). A fabricated number sharing such a line was never scanned. Separately, the number regex required a leading digit, so '.42' was missed.
bugs_found.exploit: Confirmed: '0.42 --- a substantial margin' did not flag 0.42; '.42' was not flagged.
bugs_found.fix: Neutralize placeholder tokens in-place instead of skipping the whole line (fail-closed); extend number regex to match leading-dot decimals.

bugs_found.title: Item validity certificate never gated on edit detectability
bugs_found.mechanism: detectability_status was a certificate field but was absent from BLOCKING_FIELDS and from the incomplete-review warning, so a highly-detectable (crude) edit OR an item whose detectability was never assessed could be marked evidence_eligible_candidate. The detectability probe also never writes a per-item detectability_status back to task metadata (a separate, documented wiring gap).
bugs_found.exploit: Confirmed: an item with all other fields passing but detectability unset/failing was evidence-eligible.
bugs_found.fix: Add detectability_status to BLOCKING_FIELDS: a failing value blocks, an 'unknown' (unassessed) value triggers incomplete_review_state -> not evidence-eligible (conservative).
bugs_found.residual_wiring_gap: Detectability probe output is not yet joined into per-item certificate metadata, and evidence_eligible_candidate is consumed nowhere downstream. Both require real-run integration; documented as a risk.

bugs_found.title: Release privacy audit does not text-scan the release directory (pixels only)
bugs_found.mechanism: scan_private_paths/scan_secrets use iter_text_files, which skips GENERATED_PREFIXES including 'release'. The combined audit only ran a pixel scan on --release-dir, so a /Users/... path or sk-... key inside a release config/script/README was never inspected by the gate that runs before publishing.
bugs_found.exploit: Confirmed: a release capsule text file containing a private dataset root and an OpenAI key passed audit (passed=True).
bugs_found.fix: When release_dir is supplied, additionally scan_private_paths/scan_secrets rooted AT the release dir and fold findings into the pass decision and report.

unfixed_risks.title: cvpr_ready audit check 'no_evidence_claims_from_planned_artifacts' is hardcoded True (vacuous)
unfixed_risks.why_not_fixed: Not a claim-safety hole (it never admits evidence); an honest implementation needs a real claim ledger / result manifest to check, which does not exist pre-runs.
unfixed_risks.recommendation: Wire to trace_claims()/result-manifest scan after the first real run.

unfixed_risks.title: theory_audit and result_free_completeness_audit are presence/keyword checks, not depth checks
unfixed_risks.why_not_fixed: Doc/scholarship depth cannot be auto-graded honestly; fixing would risk fabricating content.

unfixed_risks.title: tiny_pilot commands.sh chains dry-run -> execute -> GPU -> VLM with no enforced human gate
unfixed_risks.why_not_fixed: Per-command guards (run_eval --evidence-run blocks non-open-local + unreviewed; --dry-run writes nothing; set -euo pipefail + <ADE20K_ROOT> placeholder aborts blind runs) make it fail-safe; the residual is a process/doc risk. Stop-doc updated to a staged, gated next-command.

unfixed_risks.title: freeze_results marker scan skips files >= 1MB
unfixed_risks.why_not_fixed: Heuristic backstop only; primary eligibility is enforced by certification policy + provenance trace + paper-number guard.

result_free: Results sections are placeholders (expected, no runs).
result_free_completeness_audit verifies section/file presence, not argument quality.
related_work: ZERO \cite commands and no .bib across the entire paper.
related_work_matrix.yaml is an honest non-fabricating scaffold with representative_works=[] (status: needs_citations) for every category.
02_related.tex is category prose with no engagement with specific prior work.
Not submittable until a human adds verified citations.
theory_proof: 03b_theory.tex defines the estimand, bounded transform, and caveats but states NO formal theorem and contains NO proof.
The real coverage argument (Ville's inequality on a Hoeffding mixture supermartingale) lives only in the anytime_cs.py docstring; supp/proofs.tex should formalize it.
theory_audit passes on the word 'theorem'+'caveat' being present, which overstates rigor.
figures_tables: figure_manifest.yaml and table_manifest.yaml exist and are audited for structure.
All figure/table cells are result-gated placeholders; qualitative edit figures cannot exist until real photorealistic edits are generated and human-reviewed.
No real qualitative examples means the visual-quality story (the make-or-break for a vision venue) is entirely unproven.

engineering_maturity.why: 48 modules, 471 CPU tests, layered audits/CLIs; but 4 safety-gate bugs found and some audits are shallow.

reproducibility.why: Recipe-first + hashing + lockfiles + provenance + dockerless; never exercised end-to-end on real artifacts.

statistical_rigor.why: Documented native anytime-valid CS + empirical validity lab + conservative on n=1/empty/tiny-n + layered policy; paper does not formalize it.

claim_safety.why: Multiple fail-closed gates with defense-in-depth; leaks found were caught and fixed; architecture refused every fake-evidence path end-to-end.

run_readiness.why: Command bundles, dry-run/resume/max-items/provider-validation/sharding ready; pipeline never run end-to-end; commands.sh chaining is a process risk.

paper_readiness_except_results.why: All sections/manifests present and honest, but zero citations, no bib, no formal theorem -- 'except results' undersells what is missing.

construct_validity_tooling.why: Detectability probe, realism rubric, answerability, IAA, calibration, single-factor, item certificate, control edits, sentinels, leakage -- extensive; detectability now actually gates.

actual_construct_validity_evidence.why: None. No real edits, no IAA numbers, no detectability AUC on real edits.

empirical_evidence.why: Zero eligible non-smoke VLM evidence by design.

cvpr_main_submission_readiness.why: No results, no citations, no construct-validity evidence -> not submittable.

realistic_cvpr_acceptance_probability_to.why: Placeholder results + zero citations = automatic desk reject.

construct_validity.why: Conditional on edits not being trivially detectable and acceptable IAA -- irreducibly empirical.

empirical_strength.why: 1-2k items x 3-4 OPEN VLMs is solid but modest; no frontier/paid models limits reach.

novelty_significance.why: Certified intervention-consistency gap on real, single-factor, human-validated edits with the artifact confound measured is a genuinely fresh framing.

reviewer_defensibility.why: Claim-gating + provenance + anti-overclaim discipline directly defends rigor attacks; open-VLM-only scope is the main attackable point.

realistic_cvpr_acceptance_probability.why: Clean, honest, reproducible, novel framing with a real finding; modest scale + open-VLM-only + significance hinging on the result keep it from being a lock.

verdicts.highest_ceiling: A rigorous, reproducible measurement+certification PROTOCOL paper that becomes a cited benchmark; highlight-level ONLY if the empirical finding is striking and the edit-artifact confound is convincingly ruled out (certified gap that survives a low-detectability probe).

irreducible_risks: Edit realism: real diffusion edits may be trivially detectable (high AUC) -> gap confounded -> core construct invalid.
Human IAA: raters may not agree on single-factor validity / answerability -> cannot certify items at scale.
Effect existence: the intervention-consistency gap may be small/absent on open VLMs -> no eligible certified lower bound above threshold.
Cluster dependence: items sharing source scenes may violate independence -> CS coverage threatened; diagnostics may reveal a fatal structure.
Output quality on real models: parse-failure / control-spurious-flip rates may exceed policy thresholds -> ineligible.
Free-GPU feasibility: generating photorealistic edits + 3-4 VLMs over 1-2k items within free-tier limits may force the scale down.
